about.title: About Me
about.quote: True engineering is transforming complex business challenges into simple, resilient architectures.
about.intro: I am Muzaffarbek Mustafayev, a Senior Software Engineer specializing in scalable web ecosystems, real-time media streaming, and artificial intelligence (ASR & LLM) integrations.
about.stack: Leveraging React, Next.js, Node.js, Python (FastAPI), and cloud-native infrastructure to engineer robust, high-availability products.
about.experience: Extensive experience designing full-stack microservices, low-latency WebRTC streams, Uzbek speech recognition (ASR) pipelines, and managing Linux server operations.
about.interests: Passionate about distributed system reliability, cybersecurity, hardware mechatronics, and advancing speech technology research.
about.mission: To architect intelligent, enterprise-grade software systems that deliver measurable business impact with clean, maintainable code.

summary.title: Professional Summary
summary.text: Senior Software Engineer and Master's researcher specializing in scalable distributed architectures, real-time WebRTC media streams, and Speech AI (ASR) machine learning models. Backed by a rigorous foundation in Mathematics and Physics — particularly Differential Equations (ODEs/PDEs), mathematical analysis, and competitive science Olympiad achievements — empowering high-precision algorithmic optimization, digital signal processing, dynamic systems modeling, and mechatronics. Currently pursuing an M.Sc. in Mechatronics and Robotics at Tomsk State University on a State Budget Grant.

experience.title: Engineering & Research Activity
tasks: Conducted comparative benchmark analysis on Whisper, Wav2Vec 2.0, and VOSK models for the Uzbek language; published datasets and papers on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21299321)
Engineered Sammeet, a real-time WebRTC & WebSocket video-conferencing platform deployed on Linux with Nginx reverse proxy and SSL encryption
Architected scalable Full-Stack platforms and RESTful APIs using React, Next.js, Node.js, and MongoDB/PostgreSQL
Developed automated AI Telegram assistants utilizing grammY (Node.js) and Gemini / Claude LLM APIs for automated document analysis
Launched award-winning HealthTech (RuralDoc Connect) and Accessibility (Tourism for Everyone) platforms
